items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The first time I fasted I ate 9 apples a day and Father Crowley came to visit me.

ctx.x: down and took the music down." He said, "What! Get her out here!" He finally got me out to Newport where they were all wheeling like mad, like most of the priests did, to get me to write a Mass. Father O'Connor said, "Well, I tell you, if you don't write a Mass just play it, play it on the piano, Mass." I guess I had gotten myself so holy fasting and doing so many things and suffering, till they thought perhaps the music would be good. Sometimes I'd fast 9 days and just drink water for 9 days.
